verdict.rationale: Bruno has no built-in monitors. Its CLI can run collections with assertions and produce JSON/JUnit/HTML reports, and it can run in CI/CD pipelines and Docker. A developer could build scheduled checks only by wiring the CLI into an external scheduler or CI system that handles timing and alerting. The offline-only, no-cloud stance means there is no hosted scheduling service. Missing for 10: native scheduled monitor runs, built-in alerting or notifications on failure, hosted monitoring infrastructure, and any documentation of a scheduled-monitor workflow.
